denominator_semantics.average_latency_ms: Arithmetic mean over selected real sample latency_ms values.
denominator_semantics.card_count: All valid=true card annotations on selected real samples; invalid cards are excluded.
denominator_semantics.card_recognition_accuracy: Exact augment_id matches / valid card annotations. UNKNOWN is incorrect.
denominator_semantics.false_match_rate: Incorrect non-UNKNOWN augment_id predictions / valid card annotations.
denominator_semantics.icon_accuracy: Exact icon_id matches / valid card annotations. UNKNOWN is incorrect.
denominator_semantics.ocr_accuracy: Exact OCR text matches / valid card annotations. UNKNOWN is incorrect.
denominator_semantics.p95_latency_ms: Nearest-rank P95 over selected real sample latency_ms values: sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1].
denominator_semantics.sample_count: All schema-valid input samples with provenance=real; synthetic samples are excluded.
denominator_semantics.screen_detection_accuracy: Correct screen_present versus screen_detected decisions / all selected real samples.
denominator_semantics.three_cards_all_correct_rate: Samples with all three augment_id predictions correct / samples where LEFT, CENTER, and RIGHT annotations are all valid.
denominator_semantics.unknown_rate: Missing or explicit UNKNOWN card predictions / valid card annotations; UNKNOWN is not correct.

notes: Strata are descriptive comparisons only; this benchmark does not select OCR preprocessing parameters.
Unavailable rates and latency values are null rather than zero.
